t: The Rouran ruled the Mongolian steppe from 402 to 552 as a confederation led by the Yujiulü clan.
Their khagan Shelun is the first ruler recorded as using khagan as the title of a supreme steppe sovereign.
Their Turkic ironworkers under Bumin revolted in 552, destroying the khaganate and founding the Turkic Khaganate.
dyk: The Northern Wei emperor Taiwu ordered that the Rouran be called 'Ruanruan', meaning 'wriggling insects', as a deliberate insult.
ev: Shelun takes the title khagan after conquering the Gaoche
Rouran cavalry raid the Northern Wei centre of Shengle
Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei routs the khagan Datan in Mongolia
The Rouran install Kan Bozhou as king of Gaochang
The Gaoche break away under Afuzhiluo
Anagui flees to the Northern Wei, which later restores him
Bumin's Turks defeat the Rouran; Anagui kills himself
The last Rouran refugees are killed at Chang'an

f.capital: Mobile royal camp in Mongolia; Mumo (location uncertain)
f.founder: Shelun (first khagan); Mugulü, by tradition, as ancestor
